head_commit.message: feat(tui): Display keyboard shortcuts inline for approval options (#5889) Shows single-key shortcuts (y, a, n) next to approval options to make them more discoverable. Changes: - "Yes, proceed" now shows "y" shortcut - "Yes, and don't ask again" now shows "a" shortcut - "No, and tell Codex..." continues to show "esc" shortcut This improves UX by surfacing the quick keyboard shortcuts that were already functional but undiscoverable in the UI. --- Update: added parentheses for better visual clarity --------- Co-authored-by: Claude Co-authored-by: Eric Traut
